The '''Alderaan Expatriate Club''' was a club and inn located in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] that served as a meeting place for [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]]. Although it was created long before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the inn became especially popular afterward. Several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents attempted to recruit from the club's patrons.<ref name="Strongholds" />
